description: Pressure with one snap: a five-minute unrelieved ramp to the loudest passage, then a single 5-second cliff (14.0dB) at the midpoint that simultaneously collapses the spectrum and flips the harmony from minor to parallel major. The second half is the same pressure re-keyed - limiter-pinned peaks punched with sudden holes - ending on tonic major delivered as a dark, lowpassed hit and a hard stop, not a cadence.
name: anger_management

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest block (-15.4dB RMS mean). Spectrum brightens fast: centroid 1630Hz at 0:00 to ~3069Hz by 0:10. Patient, no groove statement yet.

sections.name: Slow climb
sections.notes: RMS rises monotonically by 30s blocks (-12.4 to -10.1dB) with no valley and no false drop. Tempo pushes 143.6 to ~152. Pressure accumulates - never let it off.

sections.name: First peak
sections.notes: Loudest sustained block (210-240s, -8.2dB mean). Peaks pinned at exactly 0.0dBFS at 225/235/240/245s. Least noisy passage in the track (ZCR 0.072-0.093). Tempo ~151.

sections.name: Last slam before the cliff
sections.notes: A -15.7dB hole at 285-290s, then the two loudest windows in the track (-8.1dB, -7.4dB at 290-300s) while the spectrum is already collapsing (centroid to 638Hz). The peak and the abyss share one breath.

sections.name: The cliff / abyss
sections.notes: -21.4dB at 300-305s (quietest window), -17.7dB at 305-310s; block mean -15.8dB. Key flips G# min -> G# maj at confidence 0.93 in the same window. Chroma thins to near nothing. The hinge of the whole track - dynamic, timbral, and harmonic breaks must land together.

sections.name: Rebuild
sections.notes: RMS recovers to -11.1dB; brightness climbs back over ~40s (centroid 1596Hz at 300s to 3022Hz at 340s). Key alternates G# maj / C# maj. Do not rush the rebuild - the brightness recovery is the section.

sections.name: Second statement
sections.notes: Sub-peak at 390-420s (-9.5dB block), then dips, ending in back-to-back holes -15.5dB (475-480s) and -16.5dB (480-485s) at the boundary. Same material, less stable than the first half.

sections.name: Second peak
sections.notes: RMS -10.0 to -8.8dB across the section; peaks hit 0.0dBFS in 11 windows between 490 and 565s, the densest limiter-pinning in the track. Loud, but hole-punched - never as clean as the first peak.

sections.name: Outro (darkening close)
sections.notes: Spectrum darkens hard over the final ~25s (centroid 2742 to 942Hz, rolloff 5982 to 1483Hz) while level stays loud. A -16.8dB hole at 605-610s, then one loud dark final hit (-8.4dB RMS) and a hard stop at 616.1s. No fade. Ends on tonic major, muffled - resolution as a stomp.
